description: Single-company technology profile and R&D assessment for a defined technology topic. Use when the user asks for a company technology profile, company technical analysis, R&D direction assessment, technical due diligence briefing, or any single-company-by-topic technical evaluation — even if they only mention a company plus a technology area without explicitly asking for a "profile".
